newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Securitisation deal to lift Pacific Retail.
newsitem.headline: Securitisation deal to lift Pacific Retail.

text.p: Pacific Retail Ltd said on Thursday that a deal to securitise its hire purchase contracts would give it a one-off lift of $3.0 million and lift pretax earnings by about $2.3 million annually.
Pacific Retail (formerly Noel Leeming) said it and its subsidiary, Pacific Retail Finance, had entered several conditional securitisation deals.
Essentially, it had sold the group's hire purchase receivables ledger and reduced the amount of debt on the group's balance sheet, it said.
The Bank of New Zealand will assist special purpose company Pacific Retail Securities in arranging funding to acquire the receivables.
Financial Security Assurance Inc has agreed to guarantee certain obligations of Pacific Retail Securities.

The principal advantage to shareholders of the securitisation process was the ability to access a higher sale value of its receivables because of the lower funding cost available to Pacific Retail Securities, Pacific Retail said.
